sourceHierarchy.scope: Binding on all traffic control devices on all public roads in California, including SF city streets (Standard = shall; Guidance = should; Option = may; Support = info)

sourceHierarchy.name: California Vehicle Code
sourceHierarchy.edition: Current text on leginfo (22500 captured 2026-09-04; 22352 per AB 382, Stats. 2025 ch. 555)

sourceHierarchy.name: Caltrans Highway Design Manual
sourceHierarchy.edition: 7th Edition (2020-07-01) with updates; chapters used dated 2020-07-01 to 2023-09-29; latest transmittal MCT #5 (Aug 2025)
sourceHierarchy.scope: Geometric design standards for the State Highway System only; Foreword says it does not establish a legal standard and is for Department use. For local streets crossing/within State R/W it defers to local standards or AASHTO (HDM 202.7, 308.1). Bikeway criteria (Ch. 1000, DIB 89) reach local agencies via SHC 891 unless alternatives are adopted.

sourceHierarchy.name: Caltrans Standard Plans
sourceHierarchy.edition: 2025 Edition (sheets 7-1-25, approved 2025-09-19; revised plans file updated 2026-04-20); required on Caltrans projects submitted on/after 2025-10-20 per the implementation memo (memo not re-read)
sourceHierarchy.scope: Construction details for State projects (A20A-G markers/lines, A24A-L markings, A87A curbs & driveways, A87B dikes, A88A/B curb ramps). Locals may adopt them; SF uses its own SFPW plans for curbs/ramps.

sourceHierarchy.name: San Francisco local standards
sourceHierarchy.edition: Better Streets Plan (adopted Dec 2010; Planning Code 138.1 makes recommended widths mandatory on new streets); SF Public Works Standard Plans (87,169-87,213, 2007-2012) and Accessible Street Crossing Standard RX-1..RX-11 (Order 185854, effective 2017-04-03); SFPW street-acceptance minimums (Subdivision Rules and Regulations)
sourceHierarchy.scope: Govern SF city streets for geometry (sidewalks, curbs, ramps, driveways, radii, lighting) where the State is silent; cannot override CA MUTCD or CVC. On State routes in SF the HDM governs geometry and Caltrans approval is needed for ordinances (CVC 21960 via CA MUTCD 3B.27).
